established: R19 left=0 V; R19 right=4.5 V; earlier TP5=0.066 V, all reported in the same powered red-blinking state with PIR attached. No stability statement supplied. These are resistor-end readings, not direct Q7 pad measurements.
assessment: B65/B66 subsequently confirmed both R19-to-Q7 joins at 1.5 ohm. The candidate PNP interpretation still implies about -4.5 V base-to-emitter from B63/B64, inconsistent with ordinary healthy forward-junction behavior. Identity/pin roles, measurement conditions and device behavior remain open; no fault is established.

photo_review.finding: IMG_2434 shows the paired Q7 contacts above R19, with short copper partly obscured by solder/package/silkscreen. IMG_2429 clips part of Q7/R19; IMG_2430 clips the region on its right edge. These views do not independently settle both exact joins against the new voltage conflict.

candidate_source.reference: Rev.9 Table3 gives base1, emitter2, collector3; Table8 gives typical VBE=-650 mV at IC=-2 mA/VCE=-5 V. This is a candidate-device comparison under specified test conditions, not an exact required board voltage.

next_action: Four unpowered diode readings across candidate base-emitter and base-collector pairs, both polarities. Q7 remains fitted; R19 and the surrounding circuitry can affect results, so do not identify a replacement or diagnose failure from these readings alone.
